svg.desc: Outcome of the 9,722 recorded route checks and of the same checks read off the deadline field: zero disagreements, 297 undecided cases decided, deadlines exact to one second.
svg.text: One backward pass replaces 9,722 searches

Model-relative contact field on the recorded one-hour scenarios; not a physical-safety claim. Planner deadlines: 528 of 530 origins equal the record; the other 2 were
unresolved in the record and are resolved by the field. The 186 at-issue cells were recorded as unresolved (AT_ISSUE_FAILURE) and are definite in the field; they are separate
from the 297.
